usage.callShape: POST https://stablestudio.dev/api/generate/flux-2-max/generate JSON {prompt} -> jobId; poll GET /api/jobs/{jobId} SIWX until complete
usage.outputShape: POST returns body.jobId + body.status; final image at (job-poll) body.result.imageUrl (Vercel Blob .webp). Job poll also returns body.status, body.progress, body.input, body.error.
quirks: ASYNC: the paid POST does NOT return the image - it returns {jobId, status:'pending'}. You must poll GET /api/jobs/{jobId} until status='complete', then read body.result.imageUrl.

Job polling requires SIGN-IN-WITH-X (SIWX) wallet-signature auth and MUST use the SAME wallet that paid for the generation - a different wallet identity gets 403 Unauthorized (confirmed: agentcash fetch with a different identity returned 403, qa-pay --siwx with the paying wallet returned 200).
Pays on Base (eip155:8453) USDC via x402 - this stablestudio.dev endpoint differs from the registry's prior existing-usage entry (api.xona-agent.com) which was Solana-only.
Live quote for a minimal {prompt} call was $0.07 (registry priceDisplay $0.040; guidance lists $0.04-$0.17 range; cost rises with resolution up to 4 MP).
Output defaults: resolution 1 MP, aspect_ratio 1:1, output_format webp. Result imageUrl is a Vercel Blob link that expires after ~20 min - download immediately.
Do NOT resubmit while job is pending/loading - duplicate POSTs create duplicate PAID jobs. Poll the original jobId.
There is also a /api/generate/flux-2-max/edit endpoint that takes 1-10 reference images via the upload flow.
usage.guide: Generate an image with FLUX.2 Max (Black Forest Labs). POST https://stablestudio.dev/api/generate/flux-2-max/generate with JSON {"prompt":"..."} (optionally aspect_ratio, resolution up to 4 MP, output_format). Pay ~$0.07 USDC on Base via x402. The response is async: it returns {jobId, status:"pending"} immediately, NOT the image. Poll GET https://stablestudio.dev/api/jobs/{jobId} with SIGN-IN-WITH-X auth (using the same wallet that paid - a different wallet gets 403) every ~5s until body.status=="complete", then read the finished image from body.result.imageUrl (a Vercel Blob .webp that expires in ~20 min, so download it right away). Never resubmit while pending - that creates a second paid job.
